description: This file contains a benchmark script for marshmallow serialization of complex objects, including schema definitions, data classes, and performance testing functions.

classes.name: AuthorSchema
classes.description: Marshmallow schema for author data, including custom method for full name.

classes.name: QuoteSchema
classes.description: Marshmallow schema for quote data, including nested author schema and post-dump processing.

classes.name: Author
classes.description: Data class representing an author with attributes like id, first, last, book_count, age, address.

classes.name: Quote
classes.description: Data class representing a quote with attributes like id, author, content, posted_at, book_name, page_number, line_number, col_number.

methods.name: must_not_be_blank
methods.description: Custom validator that raises ValidationError if data is empty.

methods.name: get_full_name
methods.description: Method in AuthorSchema to generate full name string.

methods.name: add_full_name
methods.description: Post-dump hook in QuoteSchema to add author's full name to output.

methods.name: run_timeit
methods.description: Function to benchmark marshmallow serialization performance, optionally profiling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, create sample data, and run the benchmark.
